_comment: Test scenario for LAMBDA. Three queries: the newest 200 location_update items (one layer per source: TrackLocation, ankle_bracelet, gps_location; drawn from their own location.point) and the newest 200 image items, shown together in a layer named "image". recent_days, limit and layer are read by hl/items.py and not sent to HL API (APP_ITEMS_PER_TYPE overrides limit). No location entities exist on LAMBDA, so the Location layer stays empty. A third query reads images from the source "EO optical (fictional)" (the Syria convoy demo, with locations) into a layer named "EO optical".
